pure-announcement.rationale: It is a repo README rather than a launch note, and its substance is coverage of literature-backed agentic patterns plus a named scoring discipline that transfers beyond the library.

duplicate.rationale: No nearest concept covers an agentic-pattern taxonomy or the deterministic-picker escape from LLM-as-scorer pathologies; retrieval-composition and Code Mode are adjacent topics, not this idea.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Every pattern row cites its source paper and the code, tests and benchmark leaderboard are public and runnable, so the claims are directly checkable.

durability.rationale: The pattern-to-paper taxonomy (Reflexion, LATS, MemGPT, CRAG...) and the deterministic-picker discipline will hold up in a year even though the README's test counts, provider extras and 78% leaderboard snapshot will drift.

actionability.rationale: The deterministic-picker rule — have the LLM commit to booleans and enums and let Python compose the deciding signal — changes how a builder designs any LLM-scoring surface, independent of installing this library.

atomicity.rationale: The note bundles two separable promotable ideas — the runnable pattern catalog and the deterministic-picker discipline — along with benchmark and packaging detail, so one paragraph cannot carry it all.
